records.narrow_fact: The SDK implements a group-worker request derivation function alongside a single-worker helper.
records.unsupported_extension: This code does not prove source manifests are signed, independent production workers are admitted or both topologies execute under sovereign governance.

records.narrow_fact: The current published route table binds the purpose-bound capability to an SDK-local semantic processor.
records.unsupported_extension: A published and locally installed route does not establish authentic external dispatch, WorkerCoordinator claims, InTr admission or custody.

records.narrow_fact: The SDK defines an execute_manifest entrypoint for this processor.
records.unsupported_extension: The function declaration and module header alone do not establish any original executed request, sovereign authority or durable external receipt.

records.narrow_fact: A local invocation helper measures monotonic invocation intervals and returns a local records packet.
records.unsupported_extension: Its timing observation dwell and local execution cannot authenticate independently originated workers or actual CPU-parallel processing.

records.narrow_fact: The partition helper divides text length by worker count and distributes remainder characters to earlier partitions.
records.unsupported_extension: This is local text partition arithmetic, not proof of independent worker execution or result custody.

records.narrow_fact: The policy validator rejects modes other than DERIVED_COST_TASK_DELAY_BUDGET.
records.unsupported_extension: Mode validation is not proof a live worker observed or complied with a real-time budget.

records.narrow_fact: The policy validator requires production_recompute_required to be true.
records.unsupported_extension: A required declaration is not independently observed production recomputation.

records.narrow_fact: The policy validator requires RECORDS_ENABLED_PACKET as decomposition target.
records.unsupported_extension: The local target is not independently verified Master Records custody.

records.narrow_fact: The policy validator requires the declared completed/failed/budget-exhausted retirement condition.
records.unsupported_extension: An accepted policy string does not establish physical worker retirement or authority revocation.

records.narrow_fact: The validator derives lifetime by summing declared time-budget components and rejects mismatched totals.
records.unsupported_extension: Arithmetic on supplied policy data is not a live cost measurement or enforced scheduler timeout.

records.narrow_fact: The local worker constructs a MATERIALIZED receipt with a null predecessor.
records.unsupported_extension: A locally synthesized receipt is not external attestation of an authentic worker materialization.

records.narrow_fact: The local worker constructs an INVOCATION_STARTED receipt linked to its immediately preceding local receipt hash.
records.unsupported_extension: A local hash link cannot independently establish a sovereign invocation or observed external activity.

records.narrow_fact: The local worker constructs a TASK_COMPLETED receipt linked to its preceding local receipt hash.
records.unsupported_extension: The local result is not evidence that a production WorkerCoordinator task completed.

records.narrow_fact: The local worker constructs a RETIRED receipt containing worker_live_after_close false.
records.unsupported_extension: That asserted local state is not independent verification of production worker retirement or Master Records closure.
